title: Robotopia Registry Entry
description: A community mod submission in the official QuantumWorks registry: one file per mod at registry/<id>.json (filename must equal the lowercase mod id). Generate with `robotopia registry add-entry`.

id.description: Stable mod id; must match the manifest name and the file name.

versions.description: Published versions, newest first. Never overwrite a released version's file — publish a new version instead.

downloadUrl.description: Absolute https URL of the hosted .robotopiamod package (e.g. a GitHub Release asset).

packageSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact hosted package bytes. The launcher refuses mismatching downloads.

manifest.description: Full robotopia.mod.json of the packaged mod, inlined so index builds never download community packages.
